caffeine-brain-development-genes.title: Caffeine may dial down genes crucial for brain development, teen finds
caffeine-brain-development-genes.desc: Data from animal studies point to a troubling possibility: Caffeine may alter brain development.

regeneron-isef-2024-gene-editing-rice-cl.title: Gene editing may help rice better withstand climate change
regeneron-isef-2024-gene-editing-rice-cl.desc: Three genes may limit the ability of rice to handle dry or salty conditions. A Regeneron ISEF finalist shows that CRISPR could target and change them.

giant-water-bugs-farm-insects-food.title: Teens work to keep giant water bugs on the menu
giant-water-bugs-farm-insects-food.desc: Many culinary cultures around the world prize these nutritious and flavorful insects. New approaches may help giant water bug farming efforts.

chewing-gum-relieve-anxiety.title: Teens invent first chewing gum to tackle anxiety
chewing-gum-relieve-anxiety.desc: Flavonoids from passionflower plants may one day give chewing gums the ability to take the edge off frazzled nerves or anxiety, report two Regeneron ISEF finalists.

regeneron-isef-2024-smart-bandage-turmer.title: This spice could be the basis of a smart, infection-fighting bandage
regeneron-isef-2024-smart-bandage-turmer.desc: Infused with yellow turmeric, the bandage turns red to highlight the pH of an infection. A teen showed that at the 2024 Regeneron ISEF competition.

kid-teen-arthritis-cell-model.title: A new cell model could help kids and teens with arthritis
kid-teen-arthritis-cell-model.desc: This model was built by a teenager with juvenile idiopathic arthritis — a poorly understood chronic illness.

antiviral-drugs-corn-chemistry-isef.title: Teen finds cheaper way to make drugs against killer viruses
antiviral-drugs-corn-chemistry-isef.desc: This drug-making achievement also nabbed the top award — and $100,000 in prize money — at the 2025 Regeneron ISEF competition.

eco-friendly-sunscreen-bananas.title: Eco-friendly sunscreen? That’s bananas!
eco-friendly-sunscreen-bananas.desc: Bananas make their own natural sunscreens. A teen thinks these could work to protect our skin as well, while being safe for aquatic life.

peroxide-fight-algal-blooms.title: Teen engineer finds eco-friendly way to fight harmful algal blooms
peroxide-fight-algal-blooms.desc: The Netflix series Outer Banks inspired this teen engineer to help clean up algal blooms in a local waterway.

regeneron-isef-2024-spinning-aerodynamic.title: Aerodynamics involved in shooting hoops can make vehicles greener
regeneron-isef-2024-spinning-aerodynamic.desc: Some ships host tall spinning cylinders that act like sails. Roughing the cylinders’ surface will greatly boost fuel efficiency, teen scientists find.

supermassive-black-holes-ancient-stars.title: Supermassive black holes might trace back to huge, ancient stars
supermassive-black-holes-ancient-stars.desc: Hefty stars might have collapsed into “intermediate mass” black holes — the building blocks of supermassive ones, a teen’s research suggests.

aerospike-rocket-nozzle-redesign.title: Nature-inspired rocket-nozzle redesign stands by for liftoff
aerospike-rocket-nozzle-redesign.desc: At the 2026 Regeneron ISEF competition, teens showed how they blasted past a problem that has limited use of super-efficient aerospike rocket engines.

2026-regeneron-isef-winners-origami.title: Origami research takes top prize at 2026 Regeneron ISEF competition
2026-regeneron-isef-winners-origami.desc: The top three winners each won at least $80,000. Other teen finalists shared in more than $7 million in prizes at this international science fair.

device-count-honeybees-varroa-mite-paras.title: A device spots and counts honeybees hosting a dangerous parasite
device-count-honeybees-varroa-mite-paras.desc: At Regeneron ISEF, three teens debuted an infrared system to detect honeybees carrying mites. It can show beekeepers when a colony needs to be treated.

soft-robots-comfort-rescue-isef.title: Soft helpers and bio-inspired tech: a match made in robot heaven
soft-robots-comfort-rescue-isef.desc: Hugging toys offer emotional support to anxious kids and slithering snake-like robots may bring rescue aid to people trapped in dangerous conditions.

teen-created-software-ids-skin-condition.title: Teen-created software IDs skin conditions, risky drivers and more
teen-created-software-ids-skin-condition.desc: Researchers at the 2023 Regeneron ISEF unveiled computer programs to diagnose skin conditions, warn of dangerous driving and translate sign language.

regeneron-isef-2024-ukraine-battle-simul.title: Teen’s battle simulator could help Ukraine’s troops fend off attacks
regeneron-isef-2024-ukraine-battle-simul.desc: At the 2024 Regeneron ISEF, Volodymyr Borysenko showcased software he created to help Ukraine defend itself in ground attacks by Russia.

ai-agent-shield-prompt-injection-attack.title: A new shield could guard AI agents against cyberattacks
ai-agent-shield-prompt-injection-attack.desc: A teen’s software could help guard AI that handles sensitive data against sneaky “prompt injection attacks.”

app-guards-against-bad-ai-agents-bots.title: Teen’s new app guards against the rise of villainous AI bots
app-guards-against-bad-ai-agents-bots.desc: Sometimes good chatbots and AI agents go rogue. A Regeneron ISEF finalist’s new app helps guard against bots developing dangerous personalities.

ai-generated-text-style-isef.title: Teen’s software for spotting AI-generated text just got personal
ai-generated-text-style-isef.desc: Rather than seeking generic signs of AI-generated text, it compares two texts to confirm they both share a writer’s unique style.

mobile-artificial-coral-reef.title: New ocean sanctuaries house young coral and even flee peril
mobile-artificial-coral-reef.desc: Two ISEF finalists want to foster growth of new coral reefs. So these teens designed and built self-navigating, undersea houseboats for coral larvae.

arctic-current-bowhead-whales.title: A changing Arctic current seems to be impacting bowhead whales
arctic-current-bowhead-whales.desc: A teen researcher investigated bowhead whales and found their migrations may be responding to a changing sea current.

magnets-gravity-plants-in-space.title: Magnets mimic gravity’s guiding hand for plants growing in space
magnets-gravity-plants-in-space.desc: Without constant gravity, plants waste energy twisting and coiling, trying to reach toward the sun. Teen ISEF finalists might have found a solution.

2024-regeneron-isef-winners-bioelectroni.title: Bioelectronics research wins top award at 2024 Regeneron ISEF
2024-regeneron-isef-winners-bioelectroni.desc: Three grand-award winners each took home at least $50,000. Hundreds more teens shared more than $9 million in prizes at the international competition.

these-young-scientists-are-passionate-ab.title: These young scientists are passionate about tech and math
these-young-scientists-are-passionate-ab.desc: The 2015 Broadcom MASTERS International delegates show why math and computer skills are key to the success of science-fair projects.

teen-designed-tech-could-expand-access-f.title: Teen-designed tech could expand access for people with disabilities
teen-designed-tech-could-expand-access-f.desc: Several inventors at the 2022 Regeneron ISEF competition offered creative solutions that translate sign language and help blind people navigate.

what-its-like-to-compete-in-the-science-.title: What it’s like to compete in the science fair ‘Olympics’
what-its-like-to-compete-in-the-science-.desc: Four recent alumni of the Regeneron International Science and Engineering Fair share their experiences.

2023-regeneron-isef-winners-exoplanets-m.title: Research on exoplanets took top award at 2023 Regeneron ISEF
2023-regeneron-isef-winners-exoplanets-m.desc: Six young researchers took home the top awards, each valued at a minimum of $50,000. Hundreds more shared nearly $9 million in prizes at international event.

baseball-pitcher-recovery-arm-health.title: How pitchers rest between innings could save their arms — and stats
baseball-pitcher-recovery-arm-health.desc: Focusing on muscle recovery during games could help keep pitch speeds high and injury risk low, one ISEF finalist finds.
